integrity: Analytic proof with exact arithmetic replay; finite checks do not establish the all-n theorem by themselves. No invented authorship, independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The original root-marked size distribution and monotone coupling are already known from Pitman (1999); the candidate novel part is the uniform-unrooted sharp LR incomparability. Only complete-graph labeled forests are treated. Full text of an earlier random-forest paper was inaccessible; stronger broad theorems might implicitly cover the conclusion. No independent priority validation.
title: Root marking creates likelihood-ratio order in Cayley forests; unrooted forests lose it at five vertices
